name: Starke
description: A man who poisoned Vuel's ritual paintings, then comforted him and opened a portal to Rath; murdered by Volrath on Mercadia.

description_citations.text: "Volrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke lies to Gerrard that he had to kill, and pledges loyalty.
timeline.quote: "I killed him because I had to," Starke lied to Gerrard. "But now I pledge my loyalty to you."

citation.text: Debt of Loyalty (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke pleads to be saved from Maraxus or condemned to his wrath.
timeline.quote: "Save me from Maraxus," Starke pleaded, "or condemn me to his wrath. Either way, do not ignore me!"

citation.text: Inner Sanctum (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Maraxus threatens Starke as a traitor.
timeline.quote: "Stroke of heat or stroke of blade. Choose your fate, traitor."

citation.text: Heat Stroke (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke decides the Oracle glanced at him once too often.
timeline.quote: Starke decided she had glanced twice too often.

citation.text: Opportunist (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath tells Starke he taught him much yet learned little.
timeline.quote: you taught me so much yet learned so little.

citation.text: Contempt (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke cries out to Takara but she obeys Volrath.
timeline.quote: It was no use—she obeyed Volrath.

citation.text: Heat of Battle (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke warns of Volrath's hungry plants.
timeline.quote: These plants aren't nice when they're hungry.

citation.text: Volrath's Gardens (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke knows the voice is Takara's but the venom is Volrath's.
timeline.quote: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

citation.text: Vendetta (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes and that its pieces were stolen from the child Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I know it to be the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke reveals that the sidar's son is alive and called Volrath, and that he knows where Volrath is and how much of the Legacy he holds.
timeline.quote: I also know he is alive and now called Volrath.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke names his price for the information: his daughter.
timeline.quote: "My daughter," Starke answered.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Maraxus corners Starke in his tent at night and threatens to kill him for betraying Volrath's secrets.
timeline.quote: "You spoke his secrets to an enemy," the figure growled.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke offers Maraxus the woman who knows where Gerrard is, claiming she can draw Gerrard from hiding, and Maraxus orders him to bring her.
timeline.quote: "Bring her," it said suddenly.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke lunges at Maraxus with his dagger but finds only darkness, as Maraxus has vanished.
timeline.quote: His blade only found darkness. The figure was gone.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Sisay tells Tahngarth she has agreed to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: This servant, Volrath, is holding Starke's daughter prisoner.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke betrays Sisay by opening a portal at Volrath's command, from which massive hands drag her away.
timeline.quote: She was alone with the traitor, alone against Volrath's power, directed at her by Starke.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay is abducted through the circle, and Starke leaves Volrath's abduction note beside her ring and flees the ship.
timeline.quote: Starke shivered as he put Volrath's abduction note on the table with Sisay's ring.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke lies to Crovax that he knows nothing of a letter but has seen Selenia in Rath, then tells him the letter was a trick to draw him away from his family.
timeline.quote: You were lured away from your home and from protecting your family.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke urges Crovax to go home, and Crovax realizes he left his family alone and stumbles off, cursed.
timeline.quote: I left them alone just so I could find Selenia. I am cursed,

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke decides to seek allies after learning Gerrard is no longer aboard the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: It's time I sought allies.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke recalls how Maraxus forced him to help take Sisay prisoner, yet Volrath and Maraxus still refused to free him or his daughter.
timeline.quote: He had gained nothing by betraying Sisay

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke finds Crovax and begs him to hide him from the warlord sent to kill him; Crovax sends him on to his friend Alaric.
timeline.quote: I have a friend, Alaric, who will hide you.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Maraxus's forces drag Starke out of Alaric's wine cellar and tear down Alaric's mansion.
timeline.quote: Maraxus's forces tore down Alaric's elegant mansion in the canyons

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Maraxus tells Starke that Alaric is dead and that Volrath is not through with him, and orders him taken to camp.
timeline.quote: "Your friend who hides you is dead," Maraxus said simply.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Tahngarth and Crovax, who rescued Starke from Maraxus's camp, walk through a canyon and Tahngarth carries the weakened Starke.
timeline.quote: since the trio had rescued Starke from Maraxus of Keld's camp

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke whispers to Gerrard that Maraxus has a secret that might kill him.
timeline.quote: "A secret that might kill him."

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Maraxus and his ogre platoon find the sleeping group at dawn and attack, demanding Starke.
timeline.quote: "Give me the traitor," Maraxus demanded of Gerrard

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke, hiding behind a boulder, stabs Maraxus in the back of the neck, and Maraxus falls dead.
timeline.quote: searching blindly for the dagger buried at the base of his neck

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke admits he killed Maraxus to stop him exposing the betrayal of Sisay, and offers to lead Gerrard to Rath for his daughter's freedom.
timeline.quote: I can lead you to Rath,

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard says he has no reason to trust Starke but needs him to reach Rath, and will watch him constantly.
timeline.quote: I have no reason at all to trust you, Starke.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke considers murdering the Oracle but her guards spoil the opportunity.
timeline.quote: He considered murdering her, but something kept him off long enough for her guards to spoil the opportunity.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke, fearing exposure of his betrayal of Sisay, decides to act against his crew.
timeline.quote: made a fateful decision to act against his crew.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke poisons the ritual paint, causing Vuel to fail his initiation.
timeline.quote: Starke poisoned the paint with which ritual tattoos were placed on his body

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard learns Starke betrayed the Phyrexians and had been feeding Sisay information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: it was none other than Starke who had betrayed his masters and had supplied Sisay with information about the Legacy

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn reveals that Starke corrupted Vuel and warns Gerrard not to trust Takara.
timeline.quote: Vuel only became Volrath when a vicious, conniving stranger came to their village and corrupted him

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara kills her father Starke before the Kyren, then reveals herself as Volrath.
timeline.quote: As the blood drains from Starke’s body, Takara metamorphoses into Volrath.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke convinces Vuel that Gerrard intends to steal his birthright.
timeline.quote: Starke il-Vec arrived and convinced the arrogant Vuel that Gerrard intended to steal his birthright

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke betrays Sisay to Volrath to lure Gerrard to Rath and free his daughter.
timeline.quote: he betrayed Sisay to Volrath and then begged the remaining crew to find Gerrard and rescue him

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke stabs Maraxus in the back after Maraxus fights Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Maraxus, fearful of Volrath's punishment for losing Starke, battled Gerrard but was stabbed in the back by Starke.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke recalls his mission to groom Vuel as evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: Starke recalls his mission to groom Vuel into a man fit to be evincar of Rath twelve years prior.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard saves Vuel on the cliff, ruining his rite of passage.
timeline.quote: Starke saw Gerrard, having scaled the cliff somehow, save Vuel from falling to his death, and ruining his rite of passage

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke gives Vuel the Touchstone and urges revenge.
timeline.quote: giving Vuel the Touchstone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath enslaves Starke as chamberlain and imprisons Takara.
timeline.quote: Volrath found Takara and imprisoned her in his dungeons

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and allies realize Takara is Volrath in disguise, who executed Starke il-Vec.
timeline.quote: Takara , their companion from Rath, was none other than Volrath in disguise.

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke, a servant of the Phyrexians, betrays Sisay and captures her and the Legacy.
timeline.quote: Sisay happily gathered them, only to be betrayed.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath steals many of Gerrard's original artifacts to thwart his destiny; the Touchstone is the first lost.
timeline.quote: stolen by his adopted brother Volrath

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vuel's trial of climbing a plateau is sabotaged by Starke's poison; Gerrard saves his life, and Vuel is cast out of his clan, even by his father.
timeline.quote: Vuel was cast out of his clan as a failure, with even his father rejecting him.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vuel is transported to Rath through Starke's portal, gives himself to Phyrexia, and becomes Volrath, evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he gave himself to Phyrexia , becoming Volrath, the new evincar of Rath, a shapeshifter and master of flowstone manipulation.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills a shapeshifted Volrath decoy; the real Volrath, in Takara's form, stows away on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Volrath had shapeshifted into the form of Takara, which enabled him to stow away aboard Weatherlight as it fled the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Mercadia Volrath turns the crew against each other, murders Starke, and tries to steal the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: He then took his revenge by murdering Starke and attempting to steal Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: "Stroke of heat or stroke of blade. Choose your fate, traitor."

citation.text: Heat Stroke (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
Contempt (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: He hunts Starke on Volrath's orders.
relations.quote: "Volrath is not through with you," he said.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

relations.quote: charge him as a traitor and slice his neck open

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Volrath executed Takara's father Starke il-Vec in vengeance for his past betrayals.

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: Vanguard Series: card flavor text (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A traitor who lies to Gerrard and pleads against Maraxus.

citation.text: Weatherlight: card flavor text (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Servant of Volrath who warns of bounty hunters and loyalty to himself.

citation.text: Tempest: card flavor text (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Volrath's former servant, taught by Volrath and warning of plants.

citation.text: Stronghold: card flavor text (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Recognizes Takara's voice with Volrath's venom.

citation.text: Mercadian Masques: card flavor text (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A character who recognized Takara's voice but Volrath's venom.

citation.text: World Championship Decks 2001: card flavor text (World Championship Decks 2001, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A scheming informant who sells knowledge of Volrath and the Legacy and then betrays Sisay to Volrath.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

pages_say.description: A scheming informant who serves both sides, betrayed Sisay to Volrath, and murders Maraxus to protect himself.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.
Tenth Edition: card flavor text (Tenth Edition, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A crew member who fears his past as a defector and his betrayal of Sisay will be exposed.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A friend who informs Crovax that Selenia left for Rath.

citation.text: "Crovax". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A human native of Rath sent to infiltrate Kondo's tribe who later joins the Weatherlight crew because the Phyrexians hold his daughter.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Takara's blind and paranoid father, said to be a conniving stranger who corrupted Vuel; he is killed by Takara.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Nemesis (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Revolution on Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Sisay". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Stole the Touchstone as an example of Gerrard's possessions.

citation.text: "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
